profile_headline: Data Science | ML | Co-founder and CTO at Recreate.ai | LinkedIn Content Creator | Mantissa DS Meetups
post_content:
Raj: What happened? You look stressed? Simran: I'm just a little worried. My
exams start in 2 days. Raj: I'm sure you'll do well! Your past data indicates
that. Simran: I'm not sure. I'm yet to cover more than half of the material.
I've barely read anything. Raj: Oh! Have you been in such a situation before?
Simran: No! And that's why I'm worried. Raj: Let me think. Maybe if we reduce
the amount of material you'd have to go through, would that help? Simran:
Definitely! But how'd you do that? Raj: We could use NLP to automatically
summarise your material. I'm just thinking if extractive or abstractive
summarisation would make more sense here. Simran: Extractive? Abstractive?
What? Raj: Do you want a summary of your material? Or extracting key sentences
would do? Simran: The latter. Because in that case I'd still be reading
through the original text, right? Raj: Yes! That's extractive summarisation.
In this case we extract important sentences from your material and stitch them
together to give you a summary that you could quickly read. Simran: And
abstractive? Raj: Abstractive would generate entirely new sentences to capture
the semantic meaning and rewrite it in concise words. Simran: Great! Can you
please help me now? Raj: Sure! Let's do it! hashtag#datascience hashtag#nlp

Unfortunately AI/ML can't detect/block bull$hit!. Still don't believe even
after seeing this on your timeline ? :)))

post_content:
Google Explore ML Academy Hyderabad has been undoubtedly one of the most
enjoyable and important events of my life 😄❤. I thank Nikita Gandhi, Siddhant
Agarwal and everyone else at Google for letting me be a part of this venture
and have such a great experience. I thank Akshay Bahadur and Sayak Paul for

from them, such as the steps involved & challenges faced in an ML project, and
also the importance of writing machine learning code with proper modularity. I
also got to be a part of a team of six to work on a project, which was later
chosen to be one out of top 3 ✌🏻😄. Siddhant Agarwal talked about the various
real life applications of ML, and some of the initiatives taken by Google for
the same. Pratyusha Simharaju talked about the importance of persuasion skills
and leadership qualities. It was great to have been amidst such a diverse
group of people with such knowledge in ML and also other domains. As a
facilitator, I will try my best to motivate others to learn, help them in
areas where I can, and thus enable them to be able to face challenges, solve
problems and create solutions for mankind with machine learning .
